description: This file defines the NodeInterface interface for Drupal, specifying methods and constants related to node entities, including publication status, promotion, sticky status, and metadata such as title and timestamps.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the node type as a string.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the node title or NULL if not set.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the node.

methods.name: setCreatedTime
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the node.

methods.name: isPromoted
methods.description: Checks if the node is promoted.

methods.name: setPromoted
methods.description: Sets the promoted status of the node.

methods.name: isSticky
methods.description: Checks if the node is sticky.

methods.name: setSticky
methods.description: Sets the sticky status of the node.

methods.name: getRevisionCreationTime
methods.description: Returns the UNIX timestamp of the revision creation time.
